api_key.label: API key file
api_key.description: The file holding your NaN API key.

interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
interval.description: Seconds between requests to the NaN API.

bar_value.label: What the bar shows
bar_value.description: The figure in the bar: the share of the period's allowance used, the credits used, or the credits left.

panel_gauge.label: Gauge
panel_gauge.description: What to draw beside the text to show how much of the allowance is used, or nothing at all.
panel_gauge.battery: A battery, draining as credits go
panel_gauge.sparkline: Credits per day, as a line

show_reset.label: Show the countdown
show_reset.description: How long until the allowance renews, next to the figure.

show_cache.label: Show the cache share
show_cache.description: Add how much of the period's input came from the cache, after the countdown.

show_icon.label: Show the NaN logo
show_icon.description: Draw the NaN logo before the text.

icon_style.label: Logo style
icon_style.description: Ghost draws the mark in the theme's own ink, white on a dark theme and black on a light one; color draws it as NaN does.

show_glyph.label: Show a glyph
show_glyph.description: Draw a glyph before the text.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: The glyph to draw when Show a glyph is on.

show_tooltip.label: Details in the tooltip
show_tooltip.description: Show the period's credits, the cache and a line per model when you hover the widget.

left_click.label: What a left click does
left_click.description: Open the panel, or do nothing. A right click opens these settings.

site_action.label: What the link buttons do
site_action.description: Open NaN's dashboard in your browser, through gio or xdg-open, or copy the address instead.

panel.title: NaN Usage
panel.prices_note: In credits, from NaN's price list of {date}.
panel.share_of_period: {share} of the {total} credits used this period
panel.frozen: Your subscription is paused, so NaN refuses credit-billed requests. Check billing on the dashboard.
panel.out_of_credits: You've used this period's credits and have no packs. NaN refuses credit-billed requests until the renewal on {date}.
panel.not_billed: This account isn't billed in credits, so there is nothing to count.
panel.waiting_hint: The poller runs inside Noctalia. If this stays empty, check the API key path in the settings.
panel.copied: The address is in your clipboard
panel.no_opener_copied: No browser opener installed, so the address is in your clipboard
panel.open_failed: Could not open the NaN dashboard
